data.title: Orise
data.about:
Orise at Maritime City Dubai, the latest masterpiece by Beyond Developments, redefines waterfront living with its harmonious blend of urban vibrancy and coastal serenity. Nestled in the prestigious Dubai Maritime City, this iconic project offers an elevated lifestyle in a prime location that bridges the charm of old Dubai with the modernity of the new. Designed by globally acclaimed architects, Orise is a beacon of sophistication, boasting panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline and the Creekside, creating an idyllic setting for refined living.

This exclusive development features a variety of residences, including 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, chalets, and duplex penthouses, catering to diverse lifestyles and preferences. With innovative floorplans and personalized interior options, Orise offers homes designed for comfort, elegance, and functionality. Set amidst lush private gardens and complemented by resort-style amenities, Orise is more than just a residence—it’s a lifestyle destination that inspires and elevates modern waterfront living

characteristics_module.title: Orise at Dubai Maritime City: Your Urban Oasis by the Waterfront
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Waterfront Location: Strategically located in Dubai Maritime City, bridging old and new Dubai with easy access to Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah.
  • Exclusive Residence Options: Offering 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, chalets, and duplex penthouses, with customizable interiors to suit personal tastes.
  • Breathtaking Views: Panoramic vistas of Dubai’s iconic skyline, the Creekside, and the serene ocean.
  • Resort-Style Amenities: Featuring infinity pools, private lush gardens, yoga studios, co-working lounges, and kids’ play areas.
  • Innovative Design: Floorplates angled for privacy and optimal sunrise-to-sunset views, blending functionality with aesthetics.
  • Sustainability-Focused: Built to Green LEED standards with eco-friendly practices and smart home automation features.
  • Exceptional Connectivity: Located near major business districts and vibrant lifestyle hubs, offering seamless access to key areas of Dubai.
  • Premium Architecture and Interiors: Designed by Nabil Gholam Architects and finished by Hirsch Bedner Associates (HBA), known for world-class craftsmanship.
  • Family-Friendly Community: Equipped with BBQ zones, children’s play areas, and vibrant green spaces, creating an inclusive lifestyle environment.
  • Exclusive Waterfront Promenade: Direct access to a vibrant promenade lined with restaurants, walking trails, and oceanfront views.

location_tile.title: Dubai Maritime City: Where Modernity Meets the Sea
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Maritime City is a prestigious coastal community that seamlessly connects old and new Dubai, offering an ideal blend of tradition and modernity. Strategically located near Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah, this waterfront destination provides unmatched convenience with proximity to key business hubs, cultural landmarks, and vibrant lifestyle attractions. Surrounded by panoramic ocean views and a thriving promenade, Dubai Maritime City is a hub of connectivity and tranquility, perfect for those seeking a refined urban lifestyle.

  • Port Rashid: 5 minutes
  • Jumeirah Beach: 10 minutes
  • La Mer Beach: 10 minutes
  • Sheikh Zayed Road: 10 minutes
  • Dubai World Trade Centre: 15 minutes
  • City Walk: 15 minutes
